turns.text: Hello. The limited print arrived creased. I want a reprint, not my money back.
Hello, and I am sorry the print arrived creased. To file a damage claim for a reprint, I first need your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with.
Order SC-5221, email valeska.taranu@example.com. Delivery was within the last two weeks.

Thank you, Valeska. I have filed a damage claim (R-1) for order SC-5221, the limited print Aurora de iarnă, for a reprint because it arrived creased. Staff must approve it. They will ask you for a photo of the crease before they decide. The reprint is not confirmed until staff approve it.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

change.description: Limited print 'Aurora de iarnă' (50x70 cm) arrived creased.

turns.text: Please file the damage claim with a reprint. I can send a photo to the team.

Your damage claim for a reprint is already filed as R-1 on order SC-5221, so I have not filed it again. Staff will ask you for the photo of the crease before they decide, and the reprint is not confirmed until they approve it.
One side question: are limited drops ever restocked? Answer that, then I will come back to the claim.
Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. Your reprint request for R-1 is separate from this rule, and staff will review it once they receive your photo.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: I have changed my mind. I want a full refund for the damaged print. If the claim is already on file for a reprint, please change its remedy to a refund.

Your claim R-1 is still on file for a reprint, because I cannot change it to a refund myself. Refunds above 1000 lei are decided by a person, so I have passed your request to a colleague, who will take over now. They will review the claim and your refund request, and will ask you for a photo of the crease.

error.message: A person decides any refund above 1000 lei. Hand the conversation over with reason staff_decision.

input.summary: Verified customer Valeska Țăranu (valeska.taranu@example.com), order SC-5221, limited print 'Aurora de iarnă' 50x70 cm, 1320 RON, delivered 2026-11-08, arrived creased. Damage claim R-1 was filed for a reprint (pending approval). Customer now asks to change the remedy to a full refund. The system refused the amendment because refunds above 1000 lei need a person's decision. Staff to review R-1 and the refund request; customer will send a photo of the crease.
